review_description: We couldn't be happier with the installation of our solar panels and battery system. Andy and the team provided plenty of options, explained them and their pros and cons, and left things with us in a friendly, non sales pressure, way, to think over and come to a decision. We made several suggested changes, and has some minor installation hurdles, all of which were smoothly dealt with. Our system has been operating for around 4 months now and has been working seamlessly.Very happy to recommend this local (to Newcastle area) solar installer.

From start to finish, the local Newcastle company, Reclaim Solar Energy, provided a top service. The Sales Manager Lauren was always available to explain and consult on our needs. She helped up to make the right decision on the size of the system we needed when other companies had not explored our particular requirements. Everything went smoothly from start to finish. We'd highly recommend them.

Reclaim Solar Energy met all our needs when it came to customer service, pricing, product quality and installation and after sales follow up. They were all very professional from the sales to installation. Install booked in, arrived as promised and delivered exactly what was quoted.The grid connection was all arranged through Reclaim and they kept us informed every step of the way with what to expect next. Cannot fault them.

Andy was awesome, he explained things in layman’s terms so I could understand the process and went above and beyond to get my system up and running. It’s good to know that I have a local service that is there to provide support only a phone call away. Thankyou Andy.

Reclaim Energy were very informative regarding the whole process, even to the point of having their Engineer speak to me on several occasions to answer a few questions about some components of the system that I had and the suitable options available. I asked for the best middle of the road equipment as the top quality parts would push the price out of my budget and that is what was installed. We also added Solar Analytics and a timer for heat the hot water system during the productive period of the day.We installed 24 panels with 2 x 5KW inverters, this gives us 2 separate 5 KW systems operating independently of each other.The work was done with no problems at all, the guys were very professional and did an extremely neat job.Highly recommend Reclaim Solar Energy!
